thesis: The tape is risk-off (QQQ below its 50- and 200-day, VIX percentile 0.833 and rising), and LFST is an extended, richly valued name bought into that regime. It closed 12.3% above its SMA20 with RSI 68.6 after an earnings spike to 15.66 was sold hard to a 13.43 close, which marks supply just 6.8% above the price. The Nov 9 move on about 6x average volume has no verified driver because the news feed was down, so an offering, holder sale or M&A cannot be ruled out. Valuation is rich (trailing P/E 81, EV/EBITDA 35) with debt above cash, and the mean analyst target of 16.3 offers little upside from 14.6. Chasing here gives poor reward/risk; the only defensible entry is a pullback toward 14.0-14.4, which is not the current price.
